name: Cody's Gastro Garage (Garden City, UT) Giant "Head-Sized" Warm Cinnamon Roll
brandOrRestaurant: Cody's Gastro Garage (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Famous across Bear Lake for being 'as large as your head'! Completely seed-free and soft yeast dough. Share it among 2-3 people to enjoy the comforting flavor without an overwhelming sugar rush.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Giant Cinnamon Roll warm with cream cheese frosting on the side so you can regulate the richness.
watchOuts: Enormous portion: split with tablemates to prevent sugar-induced diarrhea
